trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The article problematizes the assumption that archives are neutral.
trap.right: The article interrogates the assumption that archives are neutral.
trap.why: “Problematizar” é comum em português acadêmico, mas em inglês o natural é interrogate, question ou challenge an assumption.

mcq.q: Natural academic verb for “questionar uma premissa”:
Which phrase shows source and method?
opts: Drawing on customs ledgers, it argues…
It suggests, though it cannot prove,

fix.wrong: The study draws in petition files.
fix.right: The study draws on petition files.

fix.wrong: It argues what the archive is silent.
fix.right: It argues that the archive is silent.

fix.wrong: The author suggests, but cannot to prove, a link.
fix.right: The author suggests, but cannot prove, a link.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com “Drawing on”: “The paper uses customs ledgers and argues X.”
rewrite.answer: Drawing on customs ledgers, the paper argues X.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “The article argues that silence matters.”
rewrite.answer: The article argued that silence mattered.
